caption: A bicycle is turned upside down, its front wheel is given a spin, and the wheel keeps spinning for a while before stopping.

sa.check: A bicycle stands upside down on its saddle and handlebars.
Its front wheel is given a spin.
The wheel keeps spinning after the hand leaves it.
The wheel comes to a stop.
It is the front wheel that is spun.
The spin comes first, then the wheel runs on, then it stops.

pc.expect: After the spin the wheel slows steadily, turning the same way throughout, until it stops.
pc.fail: The wheel speeds up on its own; or it reverses direction as it slows; or it slows and then picks up again.

pc.expect: The wheel turns because of the one spin and comes to rest only by slowing down.
pc.fail: The wheel stops the instant the hand leaves it; or it starts turning again after stopping; or it is already turning before anything touches it.

pc.expect: The wheel stays a rigid round rim turning about its hub.
pc.fail: The rim wobbles out of round as it turns; or the spokes bend; or the tyre stretches.

pc.expect: The bicycle stays resting upside down on its saddle and handlebars.
pc.fail: The bicycle rights itself with nothing touching it; or it lifts off the ground; or it slides across the floor while the wheel spins.

pc.expect: One bicycle with its two wheels keeps its number and shape.
pc.fail: A wheel vanishes or a third one appears; or the wheel passes through the fork; or the bicycle turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bicycle's frame colour, the wheel and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes colour; or the spinning wheel changes size; or the floor beneath rearranges between frames.
